key: -RANDOM STARTER SERVICE-
en: -RANDOM STARTER SERVICE-
ja: ―ランダムスターターサービス―

key: Commit to a partner based on the whims of fate?
en: Commit to a partner based on the whims of fate?
ja: 運命の気まぐれに従って、相棒を決めますか?

key: ROLLING FOR FATE...
en: ROLLING FOR FATE...
ja: 運命を占い中……

en: CALCULATING DESTINIES...
ja: 宿命を計算中……

key: UNCROSSING THE TIMELINES...
en: UNCROSSING THE TIMELINES...
ja: 時間軸の交錯を解いています……

key: FATE HAS DECIDED.
en: FATE HAS DECIDED.
ja: 運命は決まった。

key: Custom starters cannot be obtained on randomized saves.
en: Custom starters cannot be obtained on randomized saves.
ja: カスタムスターターは、ランダマイズされたセーブデータでは入手できません。

key: Sorry for the inconvenience!
en: Sorry for the inconvenience!
ja: ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません!

key: -(NOT-SO) RANDOM STARTER SERVICE-
en: -(NOT-SO) RANDOM STARTER SERVICE-
ja: ―(そこまで)ランダムじゃないスターターサービス―

key: Commit to a partner of your choosing?
en: Commit to a partner of your choosing?
ja: 自分で選んだ相棒に決めますか?

key: Would you like to get a random starter instead?
en: Would you like to get a random starter instead?
ja: 代わりにランダムなスターターを手に入れますか?

key: (This will only pick randomly from the 21 typically- available starters.)
en: (This will only pick randomly from the 21 typically- available starters.)
ja: (通常入手可能な21種のスターターの中からランダムに選ばれます。)

key: Would you like to re-enable custom starter selection?
en: Would you like to re-enable custom starter selection?
ja: カスタムスターター選択を再び有効にしますか?

key: ADRIENN: Is everyone all set?
en: ADRIENN: Is everyone all set?
ja: アドリエンヌ: みんな、準備はいいか?

key: Wonderful.
en: Wonderful.
ja: よろしい。

key: Remember, each of you is tasked with looking out for one another.
en: Remember, each of you is tasked with looking out for one another.
ja: 忘れるな、君たちにはお互いを気にかける役目がある。

key: It's vital to take a personal interest in others.
en: It's vital to take a personal interest in others.
ja: 他者に個人的な関心を持つことは、とても大切だ。

key: Should the going get tough, you always have each other to lean on.
en: Should the going get tough, you always have each other to lean on.
ja: 事態が厳しくなっても、お互いに頼り合える。

key: ...But enough of that.
en: ...But enough of that.
ja: ……だが、その話はここまでにしよう。

key: If you head back downstairs, Victoria will take care of the rest for you.
en: If you head back downstairs, Victoria will take care of the rest for you.
ja: 下の階に戻れば、あとはヴィクトリアが面倒を見てくれる。

key: Best of luck.
en: Best of luck.
ja: 幸運を祈る。

key: ADRIENN: And that's that.
en: ADRIENN: And that's that.
ja: アドリエンヌ: これで一段落だな。

key: ADRIENN: The Crescit region, huh?
en: ADRIENN: The Crescit region, huh?
ja: アドリエンヌ: クレシット地方、か。

key: Can't say I've heard of that before,
en: Can't say I've heard of that before,
ja: 聞いたことがないな、

key: But then, I suppose there's still so much I've missed.
en: But then, I suppose there's still so much I've missed.
ja: まあ、私が見逃してきたことは、まだまだ多いのだろう。

key: Thank you again for coming today.
en: Thank you again for coming today.
ja: 今日は来てくれて、改めて感謝する。

key: I think it does the new Trainers quite well to meet their Champion.
en: I think it does the new Trainers quite well to meet their Champion.
ja: 新人トレーナーにとって、チャンピオンに会うのはいい経験になると思う。

key: ...And I find it much easier to deal with the whole caboodle when you're around.
en: ...And I find it much easier to deal with the whole caboodle when you're around.
ja: ……それに、君がいてくれると、この諸々の物事にずっと対処しやすくなる。

key: You are a backbone of strength for both of us, the region and me personally.
en: You are a backbone of strength for both of us, the region and me personally.
ja: 君は、この地方にとっても、私個人にとっても、支えとなる存在だ。

key: And I appreciate you all encouraging me to learn when to take a moment and slow down.
en: And I appreciate you all encouraging me to learn when to take a moment and slow down.
ja: それに、時には立ち止まってゆっくりすることを教えてくれた、君たち皆に感謝している。

key: Would you permit me one now?
en: Would you permit me one now?
ja: 今、少しそうさせてもらってもいいだろうか?

key: With all the day's chaos, I feel I could use a moment to breathe.
en: With all the day's chaos, I feel I could use a moment to breathe.
ja: 今日はいろいろと騒がしかったからな、少し一息つきたい気分だ。

key: I'll catch up with you this evening.
en: I'll catch up with you this evening.
ja: 今夜、また合流しよう。

key: ADRIENN: I suppose I still haven't sorted through all these books that were left up here.
en: ADRIENN: I suppose I still haven't sorted through all these books that were left up here.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ここに残されていた本を、まだ全部は整理し終えていないようだな。

key: She had an interesting collection.
en: She had an interesting collection.
ja: 彼女は面白い蔵書を持っていた。

key: ADRIENN: ...Oh, I remember reading this one as a child.
en: ADRIENN: ...Oh, I remember reading this one as a child.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……ああ、これは子供の頃に読んだ覚えがある。

key: ADRIENN: ...Ah.
en: ADRIENN: ...Ah.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……ああ。

key: I suppose that was my signature, wasn't it?
en: I suppose that was my signature, wasn't it?
ja: これは、私のサインだったな。

key: ADRIENN: Here, of all places, though?
en: ADRIENN: Here, of all places, though?
ja: アドリエンヌ: よりによって、こんな場所に?

key: ADRIENN: Well, let's start from the beginning.
en: ADRIENN: Well, let's start from the beginning.
ja: アドリエンヌ: さて、最初から始めるとしよう。
